Said 'Start's down' as Priya had asked, and flagged the crowding at the nose with a clear request. Strong execution so far. Nothing seen on leadership yet.

PRIYA: Her hands were free and the bin was stocked, so she took the bottom line herself rather than wait. This was good initiative, since it covers Leo's planned job. Her line is connected to the start and reaches about x=8.8, shorter than Maya's but steady. She asked Maya to shout when the start was down and suggested Leo save his tray for the tail and fixes. Good collaboration and ownership. Note that Maya's nose-spacing request wasn't visibly acted on, because Priya's line begins right at the nose. It didn't cause a problem that I could see.

LEO: Not at the table when I left. He went to the boxes for his own tray, though Priya had already taken the bottom line. He agreed with her, said he'd bring the tray back and then dry-run the sketch and check the joins, and he reminded Maya and Priya to give each other room at the nose. He is coordinating, but I haven't seen any domino work from him yet. Check what he did with the tray and whether the dry-run happens.

TOM: Not seen or heard on this visit. Leo says he's stocking the bin, and Priya says the bin is well stocked. I have no direct evidence of his contribution, so no view yet. Check in with him next time.

Open question: who builds the tail fork, and has anyone checked the sketch against the build?"}
